channel.title: International Finance Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Finance Magazine (internationalfinance.com)

item.title: Start-up of the Week: With its liquid-cooling systems, Frore Systems solves semiconductor's 'heat problem'
item.description: California-based semiconductor startup Frore Systems hit the headlines recently, by raising a USD 143 million Series D, led by MVP Ventures, at USD 1.64 billion valuation.

item.title: US’ climate policy uncertainty: A global macro risk
item.description: By analysing millions of newspaper articles dating back to the 1980s, these economists created a monthly index of US climate policy uncertainty that tracks legislative debates and regulatory reversals.

item.title: Sahm: Saudi Arabia’s quiet but consequential brokerage bait
item.description: Saudi Tadawul Group’s total market capitalisation reached approximately USD 2.6 trillion as of January 2026, emphasising the scale of the exchange Sahm is integrating into.

item.title: Australian households struggle to afford everyday purchases: Dr John Hawkins
item.description: Australia has been reeling under the impact of inflation, and the situation seems to worsen daily.

item.title: Malaysia voids US trade deal after SC strikes down 'Trump Tariffs'
item.description: Malaysia is the first country to invalidate US trade agreements after a landmark February 2026 ruling by the SC of the world’s largest economy, which found President Donald Trump's tariffs imposed under the IEEPA to be unconstitutional.

item.title: Deutsche Telekom remains Germany’s most valuable brand
item.description: According to BrandZ’s latest study, Deutsche Telekom has maintained its position as Germany's most valuable brand.

item.title: Through 3,730 charging points, Enel plugs in Italy’s EV future
item.description: Italian energy giant Enel has rolled out 3,730 new electric vehicle charging points throughout Italy.

item.title: Gulf shipping crisis: What cargo owners and port operators need to know
item.description: The war in the Persian Gulf is disrupting supply chains, and the costs are weighing down on cargo owners, ports, and shippers.

item.title: BNP Paribas Asset Management eyes 350-billion-euro net inflows by 2030
item.description: Following its acquisition of AXA Investment Managers in June 2025, BNP Paribas Asset Management now manages over 1.6 trillion euro, covering all asset classes and operating with varied strategies and distribution approaches.

item.title: Goldman Sachs Ayco gets new boss as it targets custodial referral market
item.description: Leading global investment banking giant Goldman Sachs Group has named Sara Naison-Tarajano as the head of Ayco, the USD 26 billion AUM division.
